① Abstract

University students face growing mental health challenges with limited, fragmented access to support. NeuroVerse is a MERN + FastAPI ecosystem that unifies self-tracking, anonymous peer community, and professional counseling in one platform.

  • Combines self-help tracking, peer support & therapist booking
  • AI chatbot Aria with hardcoded crisis guardrails (988/111)
  • Live sentiment analysis on every journal entry and forum post
  • PSS-validated stress quiz with severity feedback
  • Gamified dashboard — streaks, XP, confetti — for engagement
  • Crisis regex fires before any LLM call — zero-latency safety
  • Personalized learning paths via vector knowledge graph & DFS
Motivation
  • Student stress is increasing.
  • Many students feel lonely and anxious.
  • Students often hesitate to share problems.
  • Mental health support is not easily accessible.
Research Gap
Existing platforms usually offer:
  • Mood tracking only
  • Therapy services only
  • Self-help resources only
Problems:
  • Not student-focused
  • No anonymous support community
  • Services are spread across different platforms

AI Sentiment Pipeline (3-Tier Fallback)
① REGEX
CRISIS
Pattern match on 11 crisis keywords (e.g. "suicide", "end my life"). Returns CRISIS immediately — no LLM call. Zero latency.
② HUG.
FACE
Local emotion classifier (joy/sadness/fear/anger). Maps to POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL. Falls through to Groq on failure.
③ GROQ
LLAMA
Llama-3.3-70b via Groq API. Returns JSON sentiment + confidence + crisis_detected. Saved to MongoDB with journal entry.

⑤ Conclusion
  • Three independent services communicate via REST — no shared state
  • MongoDB document model cleanly supports 10 schemas without relational overhead
  • Regex-first crisis detection guarantees zero-latency safety before any LLM call
  • Groq hosted Llama-3.3-70b — no GPU required for production-grade inference
  • Anonymous aliases lower stigma barrier; honest peer disclosure enabled
  • HTTPOnly JWT + Helmet headers harden against XSS and common attacks
🚀 Future: Push crisis notifications · Therapist video calls · React Native mobile app
